scope: Native-only daylight isolated metre fixture of current imported skin and production timed action/guard API, normal physics advancement at30Hz. Contact captures are scheduled within one physical tick of declared .10/.14/.20/.18s contacts; source elapsed and actual rendered native bones/camera are recorded. This does not trigger world hits or vehicle sequence and is not ordinary OS input, animation phase injection, performance, mocap or subjective comfort acceptance. World sequence evidence remains separate; all native pixels require visual review.
